page.layout: One printed page on the scan, blank except for a library stamp, a handwritten shelfmark and a pencil number. No text block.
page.notes: The faint, spaced capitals and lines in the upper half ("PRAXIS", "GRAMMATICES", "DISTICHA MORALIA" and a few verse lines) are show-through from the printed leaf on the other side, not text of this page, so they are not transcribed. The round stamp "BIBLIOTHEK REICHERTSWALDE" with a crowned coat of arms, the violet handwritten shelfmark "Lib. 6,75", and the pencilled "2004 / 1583.1" are library marks and were left out.
